title.en: Increasing the Salaries of the Chief Justice and Associate Justices of the Supreme Court

text.en:
The salaries of the Chief Justice and Associate Justices of the Supreme Court are hereby fixed at
P90,000 per annum for the Chief Justice and P75,000 per annum each for the Associate Justices.

There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, such sums as may be necessary to pay the salary increases provided for in Section 1 hereof.

This Decree shall take effect immediately
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-eight.
